projectsRemoveConfirmDescription: The local folder, previous sessions, and project work records will not be deleted. Existing sessions remain available in the session list, and adding the same folder again restores the original project.
projectsNoSummary: This project has no configured summary. Existing sources remain available under Working rules.
projectsObservationSetupDescription: This project has no observation convention yet. Ask AI to inspect existing materials, recommend a work-item lifecycle and artifact scope, and prepare the project configuration, always-on rule, and project tracking Skill. Nothing is written until you confirm.
projectsObservationSetupAction: Let AI set up project observation
projectsObservationSetupPrompt: Follow the built-in project observation setup guidance to establish a durable work-tracking convention for this project. Read the existing materials, then directly propose one editable recommendation containing all three assets: .nextclaw/project.yaml, the minimal always-on section in the root AGENTS.md, and the project-specific .agents/skills/project-work-tracking/SKILL.md. A Workflow describes how one work item progresses; it is not the macro lifecycle of the whole project. Markers must be emitted before a stage starts, never batched at the end. Do not turn this into a long interview; recommend directly when the evidence is sufficient. Write nothing until I confirm, then write and verify all three files together.
projectsNoWork: No work items explicitly reported by AI
projectsWorkNeedsSetup: Set up project observation first so AI can report real progress using this project's workflow.
projectsWorkNoSessions: No conversation has started in this project yet. Once substantive project work begins, AI-reported progress will appear here.
projectsWorkNoReports: AI has not explicitly reported any work items from the existing project conversations yet. Real progress will appear here as the work continues.
projectsRunUnreported: Work item and stage not reported yet
projectsStartProjectWorkPrompt: Start working on this project. First read the project configuration and the materials relevant to this goal; I will add or revise the specific goal before sending.

projectsNoContext: No vision or working-rule sources are configured

projectsResponseWaiting: Replied; waiting for AI to update
